text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Summer training camp has begun. While the 
Umamusume push forward toward their next 
goals, Mejiro Ryan is set to skip the 
Tenno Sho (Autumn) to nurse her leg.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
For that reason, she plans to fully 
support Mejiro McQueen's training during 
the summer camp. ...All to pass on the 
baton of her hopes and dreams.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Not wanting to be outdone, Ines Fujin 
showed her motivation. She, too, felt the 
hopes and dreams of so many people.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Let's make this summer training camp 
fruitful, so Ines Fujin can come to love 
the running she cherishes even more!
